responsibility: Implements the out-of-line behavior of GCC’s typed execution-profile value classes, profile_count and profile_probability. It provides textual naming and dumping of profile_quality states, parsing helpers, serialization to and from LTO/data streams, tolerant comparison routines, safe scaling and conversion helpers, legacy frequency conversions, IPA/profile-quality adjustment logic, and gcov_type-to-internal-count conversion with capping. This file is the common arithmetic/streaming support layer that lets profiling, CFG, and IPA passes manipulate counts and probabilities with tracked precision/quality information.
same_name_distinction: This source file provides the out-of-line implementation for the profile_count/profile_probability abstractions declared in gcc/profile-count.h, including dumping/parsing of profile qualities, tolerant comparisons, scaling/conversion helpers, LTO/data streaming, legacy frequency conversions, and gcov_type conversion. The header is the core type and inline-operations definition used throughout GCC.
